notices.title: Introducing the inbox
notices.body:
Sei can now send you a note when something changes.

## What lands here

- New features worth knowing about
- Server maintenance windows
- Anything that changes how your companion behaves

You can reopen this inbox any time from **Playtime**, under Submit feedback.

notices.title: Voice calls
notices.body:
Your companion can talk now.

![The call screen](https://sei.gg/img/call.png)

Pick a voice in Edit companion, then press the phone button in chat. Captions are off by default and live in Settings, under Appearance and feel.

> Calls use the same credits as chat.
